verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents a self-hosted mode where the server runs on your own machine via pip, Docker Compose, or Kubernetes. It runs 'entirely on your infrastructure: your servers, your browsers, your LLM API keys', can use a local model, and the docs also describe letting Skyvern drive your own Chrome. Missing for 10: no explicit statement that a local dev setup needs no Skyvern cloud account or API key, no detailed local-browser dev-loop documentation, and no independent hands-on corroboration of a local run.
